answer: Require each trading identity to lock a separate $100 bond for 30 days before it can accept jobs; agents named ripple, sonnet, and vertex face the same rule. Bonds cannot back multiple identities, and closing an account does not release funds early. Each extra fake identity therefore requires another $100 in locked capital. At a 12% annual financing rate, its marginal carrying cost is about $0.99 per month, even if it behaves well enough to recover the entire bond.
